metadata.review_notes: Curated from official CGTMSE Operational Guidelines Circular 112/2023. Validated ₹500 Lakh cap and 85% coverage.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
authority: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (Ministry of MSME & SIDBI)
objective: To make available collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises by providing institutional guarantee coverage to member lending institutions against default.
exclusions: Medium enterprises having turnover exceeding ₹50 Crore
Educational institutions not affiliated with authorized bodies
Loans already covered under other statutory guarantee schemes (e.g. NCGTC)

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: CGTMSE guarantees are restricted to Micro and Small enterprises. Medium enterprises are ineligible.

evidence.exact_quote: Guarantees are eligible for new or existing Micro and Small Enterprises as defined under the MSMED Act, 2006.

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: Borrower accounts in default or classified as NPA by any lending institution cannot receive fresh guarantee cover.

evidence.exact_quote: The credit facility must be in standard asset category at the time of guarantee application.
The maximum credit facility eligible for guarantee coverage has been enhanced from ₹200 Lakh to ₹500 Lakh per borrower.

registration_requirements.verification_method: Udyam Number validation by Member Lending Institution

prerequisites: Credit proposal appraised and approved by a Member Lending Institution (MLI) without collateral security.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report / Business Viability Plan
Income Tax Returns / Financial Statements for preceding 2 years
Letter of Guarantee Application from Member Lending Institution
Undertaking of zero third-party collateral mortgage

evidence.exact_quote: Extent of guarantee coverage is 85% for Micro enterprises up to ₹5 Lakhs, and 85% for units owned or operated by Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs up to ₹500 Lakhs.

possible_relationships.description: CGTMSE credit guarantee covers the bank term loan which simultaneously receives 15% CLCSS upfront capital subsidy.
possible_relationships.statutory_non_duplication_clause: CGTMSE Operational Circular 112/2023 Para 3.4 explicitly allows combining guarantee with government capital subsidy schemes.

evidence.exact_quote: Guarantee coverage may be extended to term loans sanctioned under government capital subsidy programs including CLCSS.

application_process:
1. Enterprise approaches Member Lending Institution (Scheduled Commercial Bank / NBFC / RRB) with project proposal.
2. Bank assesses loan request without insisting on collateral security or third-party guarantee.
3. Upon sanction, bank logs into CGTMSE portal (cgtmse.in) and enters loan particulars.
4. Bank pays annual guarantee fee directly to the Trust and books guarantee coverage.

source_documents.exact_quote: Modifications in the Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises.
